name: LegendOrbs
note: Baselines are regression references. A visual change re-writes them with --approve and needs critic approval (system rule).

critic.notes: Six token-coloured lit orbs with back glow, rim light, floor pools, orbit ellipses; focus reads without narration (dev still f56/f60 standard: two green pulse rings, swell, ink label with bar, others dim to 45 percent). Arabic whole-phrase labels, item 0 on the right, no numbers, no bullets. Non-blocking: (1) committed baselines p50/p100 sit 22 and 51 frames after the focus word so the impact (rings, flash) is not in any baseline; add a baseline at focus+4f; (2) satellites 3-8 px and orbit ellipses at 16 percent alpha are faint at 960 px; (3) bottom-row labels sit at y~485/540 (about 90 percent), on the safe-margin edge; (4) no strip for the focus handoff (green to red).
